summary: Produced the backend design artefact for EXT-01 at src/design/ext-01-service-task-node.md. The design defines SERVICE_TASK activation/validation, outbound request construction (URL/method/optional headers), timeout behavior (default 30s with timeout_ms override), redirect handling as failure (no auto-follow), retry policy with exponential backoff, terminal exhausted-retry routing to OBS-05 DLQ plus EE-10 ERROR transition, success-path 2xx object merge into variables per EE-09, explicit ERROR behavior for 2xx non-object responses, API-09 trace propagation in outbound headers, idempotency and side-effect safety constraints, module boundaries, and concrete engine/api/obs touchpoints. A complete requirement traceability matrix maps all EXT-01 acceptance criteria and edge cases to implementation modules/functions and required unit/integration tests.

tests_run.name: design completeness and traceability review
tests_run.detail: Validated all EXT-01 acceptance criteria and listed edge cases against explicit design sections for activation, request construction, timeout/retry/backoff, redirect and 429 handling, 2xx merge/error behavior, DLQ/ERROR transitions, and matrix-mapped unit/integration verification hooks.
